cases.explain: In the construction 'у X был Y', Y is the grammatical subject of был ('was'), so меч stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус пошел со своими учениками на другую сторону Кедронской ___.
cases.translation: Jesus went with his disciples to the other side of the Kidron Valley.
cases.explain: The noun сторона ('side of') requires its complement in the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Тогда Иисус сказал ___, «Вложи меч в ножны.
cases.translation: Then Jesus said to Peter, 'Put the sword into its sheath.'
cases.explain: The verb сказал ('said to someone') places the person addressed in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он выхватил его, ударил ___ первосвященника и отсек ему правое ухо.
cases.translation: He drew it, struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear.
cases.explain: Ударил ('struck') takes its direct object in the accusative case; слуга, though masculine, declines like a feminine -а noun, giving слугу.

cases.sentence: Иисус пошел со своими ___ на другую сторону Кедронской долины.
cases.translation: Jesus went with his disciples to the other side of the Kidron Valley.
cases.explain: The preposition со ('with') governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я всегда учил в синагогах или в ___, там, где собираются все иудеи.
cases.translation: I always taught in synagogues or in the temple, where all the Jews gather.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('in') governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Сказав это, Иисус пошел со своими учениками на другую сторону Кедронской долины, где был сад, в который они и вошли.
reading.question: Where did Jesus go with his disciples after speaking these things?
options: To a garden across the Kidron Valley
reading.correct: To a garden across the Kidron Valley
reading.explain: Jesus went with his disciples across the Kidron Valley to a garden.

reading.ru: Они пришли с фонарями, факелами и оружием.
reading.question: What did the arresting party bring with them?
reading.explain: The soldiers and officers came with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

reading.ru: Когда Иисус сказал «Это Я», они отступили назад и упали на землю.
reading.question: What happened when Jesus said 'I am he'?
options: The arresting party drew back and fell to the ground
reading.correct: The arresting party drew back and fell to the ground
reading.explain: When Jesus said 'I am he,' the group drew back and fell to the ground.

reading.ru: Тогда Иисус сказал Петру, «Вложи меч в ножны. Разве я не должен выпить чашу, которую дал мне отец?»
reading.question: What did Jesus tell Peter after Peter cut off the servant's ear?
options: To put his sword away and accept the cup the Father gave him
reading.correct: To put his sword away and accept the cup the Father gave him
reading.explain: Jesus told Peter to put the sword away and asked if he should not drink the cup the Father gave him.

reading.ru: Анна был тестем Каяфы, который был в тот год первосвященником.
reading.question: What was Annas's relationship to Caiaphas?
options: Annas was a Pharisee rival of Caiaphas
reading.explain: Annas was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

reading.ru: Ты, случайно, не один из учеников этого человека? — спросила привратница. — Нет, — ответил Петр.
reading.question: How did Peter respond when the servant girl at the gate asked if he was one of Jesus's disciples?
options: He denied it, saying 'I am not'
He claimed to be a Roman citizen
reading.correct: He denied it, saying 'I am not'
reading.explain: Peter denied being one of Jesus's disciples, saying 'No.'

reading.ru: «Я всегда учил в синагогах или в храме, там, где собираются все иудеи».
reading.question: How does Jesus describe his teaching when questioned by the high priest?
options: He taught openly in synagogues and the temple, nothing in secret
He taught only in secret meetings
He refused to answer any questions
He taught only outside the city
reading.correct: He taught openly in synagogues and the temple, nothing in secret
reading.explain: Jesus said he always taught openly in synagogues and the temple and said nothing in secret.

reading.ru: Петр снова стал все отрицать, и в этот момент пропел петух.
reading.question: What happened immediately after Peter's third denial?
reading.explain: As Peter denied Jesus again, the rooster crowed.

reading.ru: «Царство мое — не одно из царств этого мира.
reading.question: What does Jesus tell Pilate about his kingdom?
options: His kingdom is not of this world
He has no kingdom at all
reading.correct: His kingdom is not of this world
reading.explain: Jesus tells Pilate that his kingdom is not one of the kingdoms of this world.

reading.question: What question does Pilate ask after Jesus speaks of testifying to the truth?
reading.explain: After Jesus speaks of testifying to the truth, Pilate asks, 'What is truth?'

reading.ru: Отпусти нам Вараву. Варава же был мятежником.
reading.question: Who did the crowd ask Pilate to release instead of Jesus?
reading.explain: The crowd asked Pilate to release Barabbas, who was a rebel, instead of Jesus.
